science.title: Non-relativistic radiative shock (subcritical) — reduced speed of light, Newton on gas variables, WENO3 + RK3
science.mechanism: Ensman (1994) subcritical radiative shock: a piston-driven shock in an absorbing gas develops a radiative precursor whose temperature stays below the post-shock value. The non-relativistic radiation module (RADIATION_NR) with a reduced speed of light and the default RADIATION_NEWTON_NR_GAS implicit solver, WENO3 reconstruction, RK3, HLLC for gas and radiation, and Kramers-type variable opacities.
science.distinct_from_other_rows: First of the non-relativistic module rows: it exercises the reduced-speed-of-light formulation (g_reducedC, g_radC), the radiation-limited time step and the NR Newton solver on gas variables, none of which appear in the relativistic rows.
science.failure_modes_exposed: A wrong reduced-c scaling of the radiation flux or source terms changes the precursor length; a mis-ported NR Newton Jacobian changes the post-shock temperature spike.
references: Melon Fuksman, J. D., Klahr, H., Flock, M. & Mignone, A. 2021, ApJ 906, 78 (non-relativistic radiation HD in PLUTO with reduced speed of light)

policy.active_rule: abs(candidate - reference) <= 1e-12 + 1e-8 * abs(reference) for every finite value of every declared raw binary64 DBL payload and frame; byte-identical payloads take a fast path; shape/frame/artifact/finite gates are hard gates.
policy.active_rule_status: owner-approved provisional combined tolerance shared by every row of this suite (same rule as the merged pluto-mhd-les suite); not a row-calibrated scientific error bar.
policy.case_specific_policy_shape: Precursor temperature profile; shock position at t = 0.0543; gas/radiation temperature jump; energy conservation as a secondary gate.
policy.evidence_required_before_numeric_bound: Two reproducible incumbent runs; genuinely different correct binaries (compiler/ISA/FMA); a resolution or replication study of the named observables; at least one plausible porting defect that the policy rejects; and a recorded owner decision.
policy.determinism_note: One-rank incumbent reruns are expected to be byte-identical. In the non-relativistic radiation module the time step itself is radiation-limited (RADIATION_INITIAL_DT, RADIATION_CFL_VAR_MAX with the reduced speed of light), and the implicit source step iterates to RADIATION_ERROR=1e-7 with RADIATION_MAXITER=200; both the step count and the per-step iteration count depend on floating-point comparisons. This is a DEFER/MEASURED-class hazard under references/determinism-triage.md and the reason the provisional elementwise rule is not yet a calibrated bound.

output_contract.format_family: PLUTO 'dbl' static-grid output convention (this row's shipped deck's [Static Grid Output] stanza selects dbl in single_file mode).
expected_markers: data.<NNNN>.dbl (per-dump snapshot; NNNN zero-padded frame index)
output_contract.frames: initial dump data.0000.dbl at t=0 plus 1 dump(s) every 0.0543 time units ending at tstop=0.0543 (final dump coincides with the last interval)
output_contract.byte_layout: grid.out (Src/set_grid.c) is ASCII: header comment lines, then 3 per-axis blocks each '<N>' followed by N lines '<i> <xl> <xr>' (interior points, ghosts excluded). dbl.out (Src/write_data.c) is ASCII, one line per dump: '<nfile> <time> <dt> <step> <single_file|multiple_files> <little|big> <name1> <name2> ...'. data.<NNNN>.dbl (Src/bin_io.c FileWriteData) is raw float64 with no header, native byte order, variable-major, x-fastest within each variable block, interior zones only. Variable names come from Src/var_names.c; radiation rows append enr, fr1, fr2, fr3 after the fluid block (Src/RHD/mod_defs.h, Src/HD/mod_defs.h, Src/MHD/mod_defs.h, Src/RMHD/mod_defs.h index macros). tests/checks/*/validate.py implements exactly this layout and compares every retained finite value.
